    What Are They Made Of?

    Our training pants are uniquely designed to catch the wetness inside, while keeping everything outside dry.

     

    This is thanks to our Controlled Wetness Technology, which combines absorbent padding layers that help catch small accidents and protect clothes, floors, and furniture, with a moisture-permeable barrier that helps contain leaks while still allowing your child to feel the wetness right away.
     

    They are 100% cotton and friendly for our childrens' delicate skin.

    What Makes Them Work?

    Potty training depends on feedback.

     

    Pull-ups can absorb accidents so quickly that kids barely notice what happened. KidConfident keeps the inner layer noticeably wet, giving them a clearer “I’m wet” signal while the middle and outer layers help contain the mess.

     

    That feedback helps them start connecting the dots between the feeling, the accident, and the potty.

    How Much Do They Hold?

    Unlike a lot of the other training pants out there — ours actually work at preventing leaks. Our product team spent months sampling dozens of fabrics to finally create our unique Controlled Wetness Technology. 

     

    This layer allows our training pants to be comfy and cozy just like regular undies — with a secret superpower that allows them to stay wet on the inside, while preventing most leaks to the outside.

    The Essential Piece Most Potty Training Methods Overlook

    Potty training is a learning process — and learning needs feedback.

     

    Pull-ups are designed to absorb accidents quickly, so kids may barely notice the wetness at all. And if they don’t really feel what happened, there’s less for them to connect back to the potty.

     

    KidConfident keeps the feeling noticeable on the inside while helping contain small accidents on the outside — so they can feel it, notice it, and start connecting the dots.

    How Our Simple Solution Makes It Click In Just Days

    KidConfident is built to do two things at once that normally compete with each other: Let them feel the accident — while helping contain it.

     

    Our layered design keeps the inner fabric noticeably wet, while absorbent middle layers catch small accidents and the outer barrier helps protect clothes, floors, and furniture.

     

    So your child gets the clear cause-and-effect signal they need to learn, without you having to choose between pull-ups that hide everything and underwear that leaves puddles everywhere.

     

    They get the feedback. You skip most of the mess.

    The Reason It Works
    For 95% Of Families

    Pull-Ups Can Hide The Feedback They Need

    Disposable pull-ups are designed to make accidents disappear quickly.

    But when kids barely notice the wetness, they get a much weaker cause-and-effect signal from what just happened. That can make it harder to build the body awareness potty training depends on.

    So even with reminders, rewards, and routines, the most important learning signal can still be missing.

    Accident → Wetness disappears → Little feedback → Less to learn from

    Letting Them Learn Through Feeling

    KidConfident is built around one simple idea: kids learn faster when they can actually notice what happened.

    Our layered design keeps wetness noticeable on the inside while helping contain small accidents on the outside.

    That gives them the feedback they need to start connecting the sensation with the accident — and eventually, with the potty.

    They get the feedback. You skip most of the mess.

    From Accidents To Awareness

    At first, the change can be as simple as your child actually noticing when an accident happens.

    Then they may begin telling you afterward, reacting sooner, or heading toward the potty on their own.

    As that connection gets stronger, the goal is for them to recognize the body's signal before the accident — so potty trips become more self-initiated and independent.

    Feel → Notice → Connect → Act

    Frequently Asked Questions

    how are these different than pull-ups?

    Pull-ups are designed to absorb wetness quickly. KidConfident is designed to keep the feeling noticeable while helping contain small accidents — giving kids the feedback they need to start connecting the dots.

    what if my child doesn't care about being wet?

    That’s actually pretty common at first. The goal isn’t for them to hate being wet — it’s for them to notice it.

     

    KidConfident keeps the sensation more noticeable than a pull-up, so even if they don’t react right away, they’re getting clearer feedback each time. 

     

    Over repeated accidents, that can help them start connecting “I’m wet” → “I peed” → “I should use the potty.”

    can they be used overnight?

    KidConfident training pants are designed primarily for daytime potty training, since overnight accidents are usually larger and happen while your child is asleep.

     

    For bedtime, you can add our Leakproof Undie Covers over their KidConfident training pants for extra overnight protection and fewer sheet changes.

    how do i know if my child is ready to potty train?

    There isn’t one perfect age or “readiness date.” Potty training starts with body awareness — noticing the signals their body is already sending.

     

    That’s why we recommend focusing less on waiting for the perfect moment and more on giving them clear feedback. Staying in highly absorbent pull-ups for too long can make wetness easier to ignore, while KidConfident helps keep that feedback noticeable so they can start connecting feeling → accident → potty.

    why does potty training seem to take longer for kids today?

    There’s probably no single reason, but one big thing has changed: disposables have gotten much better at making accidents disappear.

     

    That’s great for preventing messes — but it can also make wetness less noticeable. And when kids get less feedback from an accident, there’s less opportunity to build the body awareness potty training depends on.

     

    KidConfident is designed to bring that feedback back: feel it → notice it → connect the dots.

    do you have sizes for older kids?

    Yes! We offer Big Kid Sizes specifically for older children and extended potty training. They use the same KidConfident learning approach, just in larger sizes designed for bigger kids.

    what is your exchange & return policy?

    Our exchange and return policy is covered by our Parent Promise.

     

    If our Kid Confident products don't help your child progress in the potty training process within 60 days, we offer a full refund with no questions asked. We're committed to ensuring your satisfaction and supporting your family's potty training journey.
